stories.title: Medvedev Wins Hangzhou Open — Defeats Rublev 7-5, 6-4

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Medvedev wins the Hangzhou Open. 🎾

Final: Medvedev def. Rublev 7-5, 6-4

23 aces. Never dropped serve. 93 minutes.

His 24th career title — and 3rd of 2026 (Brisbane, Dubai, Hangzhou). #tennis #HangzhouOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Medvedev vs. Rublev all-time record now: 8-2.

Rublev earned his 400th career ATP win just to get to today's final.

Medvedev did not care. Not one broken serve. #tennis #ATP

stories.title: Davidovich Fokina Wins Chengdu — Comeback Title on Return from Injury

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Davidovich Fokina wins the Chengdu Open on RETURN from injury. 🏆

Hadn't played since July. Lower back. 3 months out.

First tournament back — he won it.

6-4, 7-6 over Hurkacz. Never faced a break point. #tennis #ChengduOpen

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
In the Chengdu tiebreak: Davidovich Fokina saved FOUR set points.

Won it 9-7.

A first-ever hard court title. His second career ATP title overall.

"I want to dedicate this to my whole team." #tennis #ATP

stories.title: China Open 2026 Opens — Djokovic Returns to Beijing, Rybakina Leads WTA

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
The China Open is open. 🇨🇳

Djokovic is back in Beijing for the first time since 2015.

His record there: 29-0. Six titles.

Up first: vs. Borges.

Meanwhile, Rybakina enters as the new World No. 1. #ChinaOpen #tennis

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
China Open WTA draw intrigue:

Gauff and Swiatek are in the same quarter.

Their 17th career meeting — Swiatek leads 11-5, but Gauff won their only 2026 meeting.

Rybakina. Sabalenka. Gauff. Swiatek. What a field. #WTA #tennis

stories.title: Sinner Withdraws from China Open — Targets Shanghai Return

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Sinner is out of the China Open.

Official: "My knee is not where I would like it to be and I'm not ready to compete yet."

Next target: Shanghai Masters (Oct 7).

He's now missed the Canadian Open, Cincinnati, US Open, and Beijing. #Sinner #tennis

stories.title: Rybakina at No. 1 — China Open Marks First WTA 1000 as World No. 1

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Elena Rybakina steps on court in Beijing this week as World No. 1.

The first Kazakh player — man or woman — ever to hold the top ranking.

Wimbledon 2022. Australian Open 2026. US Open 2026.

Three Slams. Now No. 1. #WTA #tennis #Rybakina
